threads.body: [General] Clear the attached target when recomputation fails. This method also runs after `setHost`/`setPort`; if a reconfiguration changes a previously valid target to an unrepresentable value, this guard retains the old `VirtualField` entry and later spans report stale server data. `VirtualField.set(..., null)` clears the entry, so store `target` unconditionally.

[Testing] The PR promises configured targets for metrics too, but the new sharded coverage asserts only span names and attributes. The existing direct-client metric assertion checks attribute keys rather than values, so it would not catch a regression where `db.client.operation.duration` still reports the selected shard instead of the configured shard list. Please add a stable-semconv metric assertion for the sharded command that verifies the `server.address` value and omitted `server.port`.

replies.body:
Addressed in b9dbe55b118e20212677a5acdf3bd3665f32f052.

Analysis: The existing sharded test verifies configured targets only on spans. A stable metric regression could still report the selected shard because the shared metric helper checks keys but not values. The new exact metric point assertions require both operations to report the configured shard list and exclude server.port.

Upsides: The test now protects configured-target values for SET and GET metrics and verifies the stable attribute set.

Downsides: The test adds one metric collection assertion to the stable-semconv run.

threads.body: `RedisServerTarget.ofEndpoints()` intentionally renders at most the first five endpoints and truncates at 255 characters, so valid sharded configurations beyond those limits do not report “every configured shard” as the PR description states. Please reconcile the promised behavior with this bounded representation and add boundary coverage for whichever contract is intended.

replies.body:
Addressed in 36e7776daa9279bbb748536b88fc0490477f0358.

The intended contract is the shared bounded Redis target representation. Added Jedis-specific coverage for the five-endpoint and 255-character boundaries.

threads.body: [General] This ambient scope covers all of `Sharded.initialize()`, including the overridable `JedisShardInfo.createResource()` callback that the new reentrancy test relies on. An unrelated Jedis created or used by that callback is therefore assigned/reported with the outer shard list; additionally, if `createServerTarget()` throws in a nested call, suppressed enter advice yields a null `@Advice.Enter` and exit clears the still-active outer target. Attach the configured target to each actual initialized shard resource instead of treating every same-thread connection as a shard; if a scope remains, carry an explicit successfully-installed state so exit cannot clear an outer scope after enter failure.

replies.body:
Addressed in 36e7776daa9279bbb748536b88fc0490477f0358.

Removed the ambient scope and now attach the configured target only to the initialized Sharded instance's actual resources. Added reentrant callback coverage.
